endpoint: first 128 native committed generated IDs, or earlier inclusive first EOG; prompt and rejected proposal IDs excluded
fixed_sequence: shared R0 and B timer R0
joint source and per-arm runtime freeze push
A H1 exposed discovery 36 predictor + 36 batched

prediction.question: Does a discovery-selected predictor transfer prospectively to complete RTX batched trajectories?
prediction.harness_definition: original common CLI target-only frontend/sampler UB1, fresh process, empirically reproduces every archived reference; H1 changes only UB2
prediction.H1: target-only common CLI frontend UB2; actual native decode partitions retained; parameter name alone is not mechanism evidence
prediction.H2: fixed proposal target verification replay; permitted only with independent pre-live proposal tape generator. Pinned CLI has no fixed tape importer/generator. No reserved live call is allowed to produce that tape. If no independent generator can be specified, H2 is unavailable and A stops.
prediction.decision: H1 complete discovery equality 36/36 selects H1; otherwise examine H2 availability, require H2 36/36 if implementable; else MECHANISM_NOT_ISOLATED. No H3/search.
prediction.reserved_reference_predictor_order: selection rank; repetitions 1..3; TARGET_REFERENCE then selected predictor
prediction.success: 72/72 full-array predictor/live equality; at least one actual reference-divergent correctly predicted prompt for discrimination

latency.question: What is matched post-prefill latency on a freshly qualified serialized RTX path?
latency.timer_start: after synchronized target and draft initial prompt prefill; before request sampler constructor/seed/reset/prompt acceptance and common_speculative_begin
latency.timer_end: after last committed generated ID, target/draft synchronization and required slot release; includes final response/log work before release; excludes model destruction
latency.secondary_timer: separate std::chrono::steady_clock start/end record; APIs share Windows clock oscillator
latency.r0_hook_threshold: 10000 pairs of QPC/steady-clock records: p99 empty-hook <= 10 microseconds and p99 < 1% shortest R0 interval; Python ctypes probe provides conservative clock-call overhead bound
latency.qualification: 90/90 complete new serialized/reference ID arrays AND 180 valid native timer/device records; otherwise no speed estimate
latency.estimator: for each prompt median of 3 reference milliseconds divided by median of 3 serialized milliseconds; geometric mean over 30 prompt ratios

thermal_rule.pre_B: minimum 120s idle; three 10s-separated samples utilization<=5%, GPU temp<=55C, spread<=2C; maximum 600s then operational stop
thermal_rule.pre_each_run: fixed 2s idle; thermal/device snapshots before and after, no outcome-dependent delays
thermal_rule.clock_lock: no unsupported clock lock; observed clocks preserved; prompt pairing randomized

planned_counts.H2_if_available: 36 replay plus separately counted tape generation

failures: retain every failure/mismatch; mismatch continues, operational failure stops affected arm; no selective replacement/restart after formal data; A failure does not alter frozen B
immutable: old v2, old timing, manuscripts and PR40 untouched; no auto merge
